access.excel_search: The s001 Figshare record registers only its PDF. The SI refers to generated Excel grain data, but that spreadsheet was not located. Root separately acquired the s002 presentation from Figshare record 29185194: it contains four slides, four MP4 videos, four preview PNGs and no embedded workbook. This is additional visual source material, not a compatible numeric measurement table.

second_supplement.review: Slide XML and archive inventory inspected; root viewed one preview image. Videos were not analyzed or digitized.

results.eligibility: Ineligible for the frozen amino/glyco2 numeric external evaluation: no machine-readable per-run observations were publicly acquired; the SI reports 1 mM low-molecular-mass conditions and assay outputs across multiple times, which are condition-shift context rather than the benchmark 20/22 mM protocols.

results.title: Self-assembled nanostructures of 3ph-imi[FeCl4] as a strong ice recrystallization inhibitor

access.crossref: HTTP 200; publication metadata and Elsevier PII link verified
access.content_review: Root inspected DOCX XML text and object relationships. Tables S1-S3 cover surface tension, representative literature IRI activity, and DSC. No per-run grain-area table was found in the document text. Fifteen embedded OLE objects remain in the original file: seven Origin graphs associated with spectroscopy/energy spectra/nucleation figures, and eight ChemDraw objects in the literature-comparison table. Their internal numeric data were not decoded; they are not established as absent. No eligible IRI observations were acquired from those objects.

embedded_objects.inspection: Program IDs and adjacent figure captions from Word XML; no object executed

results.eligibility: Ineligible for frozen-model scoring: the source is an ionic-liquid/self-assembled nanostructure series with unresolved comparability to the benchmark. No qualifying per-run grain observations were acquired. Table S2 repeats literature values and must not be counted as new independent measurements. Retain as a methods/condition-shift lead only.
